extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/practitioners before the USPTO (respondents in OED disciplinary/reinstatement matters)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural/eligibility steps and decision criterion for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO after suspension, focusing on filing an affidavit of compliance under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 and the Director's review of the petition and affidavit. Applies to practitioners suspended from practice seeking reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit certifying compliance with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: "On June 29, 2012, Ms. Massicotte filed an Affidavit certifying compliance with the requirements of 37 CFR § 11.58."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing an affidavit that certifies compliance with the requirements of 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is a prerequisite step in a reinstatement matter; the affidavit is a documented representation that the suspended practitioner meets the regulatory conditions for seeking reinstatement. (Page shows the affidavit was filed and dated.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing a Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: "Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Ms. Massicotte, received on August 16, 2012."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A formal Petition for Reinstatement must be submitted and will be considered by the Office. The petition's receipt date is noted as part of the record; the petition is considered together with the affidavit of compliance when evaluating reinstatement requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's discretionary determination of appropriateness to grant reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: "After careful review of the Petition and Affidavit, the Director of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement is subject to the Director's review and discretionary determination based on the petition and accompanying affidavit(s). The Director may grant reinstatement when, after review, the requirements and circumstances indicate reinstatement is appropriate. This document exemplifies the Director exercising that discretion to grant reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service/notification of decision (entry on record)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Copy to: Ms. Michelle A. Massicotte 28 Waldron Court Marblehead, MA 01945"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision is entered on the Office record and a copy is served/notified to the practitioner (addressed). Maintaining and providing notice of the decision to the respondent/practitioner is part of the procedural disposition.
